- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/sepa-direct-debit/configuration/): 1.
- [Client-Side Implementation](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/sepa-direct-debit/client-side/): SEPA Direct Debit is available to eligible merchants using a custom client-side integration. It is only available in Android v4.13+, iOS v5.11+, and JavaScript v3 SDK.
